headline: A clear pattern emerged in your trade sizing.

size_up_after_loss.why_it_matters: The cost of this pattern was ₹1,05,732. It involved 96 after‑loss trades where the median entry size after a loss was ₹12,562 compared with your usual median size of ₹6,578, giving a size ratio of 1.91x. Those after‑loss trades produced a loss of ₹1,95,375, with a win rate of 28% versus 39% on other trades.
size_up_after_loss.rule: After a loss, your next entry is your usual size.

averaging_down.note: This pattern is emerging and is worth watching.

closing: Consider using the rule “After a loss, your next entry is your usual size” next month.
